branchTest.name: branchTest
branchTest.help: What decides which way this entry branches: the time of day, the playlist's loop count, or an MQTT message.

startTime.name: startTime
startTime.help: Start of the time window that counts as True. Outside the window the test is False.

endTime.name: endTime
endTime.help: End of the time window that counts as True.

loopTest.name: loopTest
loopTest.help: How the playlist's loop count is tested. Iteration matches particular times round the playlist.

iterationStart.name: iterationStart
iterationStart.help: The first time round the playlist at which the test can be True.

iterationCount.name: iterationCount
iterationCount.help: How often, in loops, the test is True after the starting iteration - for example every 2 loops.

mqttTopic.name: mqttTopic
mqttTopic.help: MQTT topic watched for a message. The test is True while the topic's last message matches the text below.

mqttMessage.name: mqttMessage
mqttMessage.help: Message text that has to match for the test to be True.

trueNextBranchType.name: trueNextBranchType
trueNextBranchType.help: What happens when the test passes: carry on as normal, jump to a fixed entry, jump a number of entries, or run another playlist.

trueNextSection.name: trueNextSection
trueNextSection.help: Section of this playlist the jump lands in. '** Same **' stays in the section this entry is in.

trueNextItem.name: trueNextItem
trueNextItem.help: Entry to jump to - the entry number for Jump to Index, or how many entries to move for Jump to Offset (negative moves backwards).

trueBranchPlaylist.name: trueBranchPlaylist
trueBranchPlaylist.help: The playlist to run when the test passes.

falseNextBranchType.name: falseNextBranchType
falseNextBranchType.help: What happens when the test fails: carry on as normal, jump to a fixed entry, jump a number of entries, or run another playlist.

falseNextSection.name: falseNextSection
falseNextSection.help: Section of this playlist the jump lands in. '** Same **' stays in the section this entry is in.

falseNextItem.name: falseNextItem
falseNextItem.help: Entry to jump to - the entry number for Jump to Index, or how many entries to move for Jump to Offset (negative moves backwards).

falseBranchPlaylist.name: falseBranchPlaylist
falseBranchPlaylist.help: The playlist to run when the test fails.

note.name: note
note.help: Free-form note about this entry, for your own reference. Whether it is shown in the playlist list is controlled by Display Mode; it has no effect on playback.

displayMode.name: displayMode
displayMode.help: What this entry shows in the playlist list: its settings (Args Only), its note (Just Note), or both.

subType.name: subType
subType.help: Where the list of entries to play is fetched from: a JSON file on this player, a plugin, or a URL.

dataFile.name: dataFile
dataFile.help: Full name of the JSON file, in the media directory, holding the playlist entries to play.
dataFile.placeholder: Full File Name of JSON file

pluginName.name: pluginName
pluginName.help: The plugin asked to supply the playlist entries to play.

pluginHost.name: pluginHost
pluginHost.help: Which FPP instance the plugin is asked on. Leave as the local host to use the plugin running on this player.

url.name: url
url.help: URL returning JSON playlist entries. It is fetched each time this entry is reached.

drainQueue.name: drainQueue
drainQueue.help: If checked, every entry supplied is played before moving on. If unchecked, only the first is played and the rest are left for the next time round.

note.help: Free-form note about this entry, for your own reference. Whether it is shown in the playlist list is controlled by Display Mode; it has no effect on playback.

displayMode.help: What this entry shows in the playlist list: its settings (Args Only), its note (Just Note), or both.

command.name: command
command.help: The FPP command to run at this point in the playlist. The arguments below change to match the command you pick.

multisyncCommand.name: multisyncCommand
multisyncCommand.help: Also send this command to other FPP instances instead of running it only on this player.

multisyncHosts.name: multisyncHosts
multisyncHosts.help: Which remote FPP instances receive the command. Leave empty to broadcast to all of them.

imagePath.name: imagePath
imagePath.help: The image file to display, from the images directory.

imageFilename.name: imageFilename
imageFilename.help: Name of the image file currently being displayed.

modelName.name: modelName
modelName.help: The Pixel Overlay Model the image is drawn onto. Models are defined under Content Setup > Pixel Overlay Models.

displayMode.name: displayMode
displayMode.help: What this entry shows in the playlist list: its settings (Args Only), its note (Just Note), or both.

fileMode.name: fileMode
fileMode.help: Play one specific file, or pick a random video / audio file from the media directory each time this entry runs.

mediaName.name: mediaName
mediaName.help: The audio or video file to play. The list comes from the media directory - upload files under Content Setup > File Manager.

mediaPrefix.name: mediaPrefix
mediaPrefix.description: Play files starting with this prefix only
mediaPrefix.help: In random mode, only files whose name starts with this text are considered. Leave blank to allow any media file.

videoOut.name: videoOut
videoOut.help: Where video from this entry is sent (HDMI, a Pixel Overlay Model, etc). '--Default--' uses the global Video Output setting from Settings > Playback.

streamSlot.name: streamSlot
streamSlot.help: Stream slot (1-5) this entry's media plays on. Entries on different slots can play at the same time; entries sharing a slot interrupt each other.

extraMediaName.name: extraMediaName
extraMediaName.help: Optional second media file played at the same time as the main media, for example a second audio track for another zone or a separate video output.

extraMediaOut.name: extraMediaOut
extraMediaOut.help: Where video from the extra media file is sent. '--Default--' uses the global Video Output setting.

extraMediaSlot.name: extraMediaSlot
extraMediaSlot.help: Stream slot (2-5) the extra media plays on. It must differ from the main media's Stream Slot so the two play together instead of interrupting each other.

timecode.help: This entry's position on the show's master time code (HH:MM:SS), used when playback position is driven by an external time code or sync source. 'Default' works the position out from the length of the entries before it.

duration.name: duration
duration.help: How long to pause, in seconds, before moving on to the next entry. Outputs keep sending their last values during the pause.

source.name: source

destination.name: destination
destination.help: First channel number that is copied to.

count.name: count
count.help: How many consecutive channels are copied, starting at Source.

loops.name: loops
loops.help: How many times the block of channels is repeated, each repeat landing after the previous one.

reverse.name: reverse
reverse.help: Copy the block of channels in reverse order, so the last source channel maps to the first destination channel.
